sections.h2: What nursing home management software should be
paras: Nursing home management software is hospital software sized for a facility where the owner is also a consultant, the nursing staff keep most of the records and one or two people at the desk handle registration, billing and the pharmacy counter. HIMS covers that whole facility, OP, beds, nursing charts, pharmacy, laboratory if you have one, and cash, insurance and TPA billing, without asking you to hire an IT team to run it.

The point of one platform in a small facility is not scale; it is that the same person does several jobs. When the desk registers a patient, allocates the bed, dispenses the drugs and raises the bill from one screen, nothing is written twice and nothing is forgotten at discharge. Setup is done by the founder who built the software, in person in Chennai or remotely elsewhere, with support on WhatsApp after go-live.

sections.h2: Hospital software is usually built for a hospital with an IT department. A nursing home has a receptionist.
sections.lead: The systems on offer are either too big to run or too small to cover the wards.

items.q: Is HIMS too big for a nursing home?
items.a: No. You switch on the modules you use, typically OP, beds, nursing, pharmacy and billing, and leave the rest until you need them. The record structure is the same, so adding a laboratory or imaging later does not mean a migration.

items.q: How much staff training is needed?
items.a: The front desk, the nursing station and the pharmacy counter each learn their own screens. Setup and training are done by the founder who built the software, in person in Chennai or remotely elsewhere in India, with support on WhatsApp afterwards.

items.q: Can we handle TPA cases without a TPA desk?
items.a: Yes. Pre-authorisation is recorded at admission and claim documents come from the record at discharge, so the desk can prepare a claim without the consultant doing it. See TPA billing software.

items.q: Do we need our own server?
items.a: No. HIMS is deployed in the cloud and used from a browser on the computers you already have. Imaging through AuraPACS uses an on-premise node on your network if you add it.

items.q: Does it cover a small laboratory?
items.a: Yes. The laboratory module takes orders from the consultant, tracks the sample and releases a verified result to the record. See hospital laboratory management.

items.q: How quickly can a nursing home go live?
items.a: HIMS is delivered on a 30-working-day framework where scope allows, and a nursing home's scope is usually well within it. Your existing patient list can be brought in from Excel.
